_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values so extracted.

requests_2024.basis: spring 2024 requests to regrade open-ended reading answers

growth_2024_to_2026.basis: requests_2026 // requests_2024, rounded down so 'more than N times' holds

scores_raised_min.basis: reading scores the state raised after the reviews, a floor

human_one_in.basis: 100 / human_pct_min, so at least one in this many answers also goes to people, TEA's design as of Dec 2023 and Mar 2024

changed_pct_max.basis: fewer than this percent of all open-ended reading responses changed, a ceiling; printed in words as fewer than half of one percent

changed_one_in.basis: 100 / changed_pct_max: fewer than one in this many open-ended reading responses changed, a ceiling; drawn on slide 7 as one gilded page among this many and printed on slide 7 as the single gilded page in 200

fee_usd.basis: per test, charged when the score does not change

dallas_tests_min.basis: Dallas ISD reading tests sent for rescoring, a floor

dallas_higher_pct.basis: share of Dallas ISD's that came back higher

human_pct_min.basis: share of answers also routed to people, TEA's design as of Dec 2023 and Mar 2024

training_responses.basis: about this many human scored field test responses program the engine per question

hand_cost_low_musd.basis: extra cost per year of scoring by hand, low end

scorers_multiple_low.basis: four to five times as many human scorers

responses_multiple_low.basis: 6-7x more constructed responses to grade each year
